newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices slip in thin featureless market.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices slip in thin featureless market.

text.p: Danish bond prices slipped during Monday morning on a thin market devoid of major indicators from home or abroad.
"The only important data the market is waiting for is U.S. consumer confidence on Tuesday and even then there is no longer anybody that expects a rate rise over there," a dealer said.
"U.S. indicators are so good for the moment that the earliest the market expects any rate action is August," he said.
At 1145 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 111.76, yielding 6.20 percent, down from Friday's 111.88.
